subject: Quick pulse: final microcycle approval & budget priority?
body:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Oliver Hayes <oliver.hayes@lumenahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery recap + suggested next steps (SOW draft attached)

Hi Oliver —

Thanks again for taking the call yesterday. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum as you close the microcycle budget window: 

- Goal: pilot Redwood inference for patient triage NLP across 3 clinics (target 10k monthly requests).
- Success metrics: sub-200ms p95 latency for single-request flow, < $0.003/token steady-state, and no PHI logged outside your VPC.
- Risk controls: SOC2 evidence, VPC private deployment option, and per-route tracing we reviewed.

Proposed next steps:
1) You share preferred procurement timeline and any mandatory contract clauses (by end of week if possible).
2) We provide an SOW + pilot plan (attached Lumena_SOW_v1.pdf).
3) If budget/approvals are on track, schedule a short handoff with your infra/security owners next week.

I'm attaching the draft SOW and my discovery notes (discovery-notes.docx). Happy to tighten scope — we can compress the pilot to a 2-week canary if that helps approvals. 

Can you confirm whether the procurement window for this microcycle is still nominally open on your side? If there's a priority shift, say so and we can pause the SOW cadence.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0123

--
Attachment: Lumena_SOW_v1.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: discovery-notes.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

-----Original Message-----
From: Oliver Hayes <oliver.hayes@lumenahealth.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:33:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + suggested next steps (SOW draft attached)

Hi Priya —

Appreciate the clear recap and the SOW. Quick notes from my side: 
- The pilot looks aligned to what we discussed; SLA/PHI constraints are the main gating items for procurement.
- I'll need to route the SOW to procurement and our security lead (Samantha). Expect some redlines around data residency and contract term language.

I'm on annual planning this week — I should be able to get initial feedback to you by Monday. If the approval timeline slips we may need to push into the next microcycle.

Best,
Oliver
VP of Engineering | Lumena Health

On Fri, Nov 20, 2026 at 11:02 AM Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Thanks Oliver — noted. I'll loop in Marissa (CS) for the technical handoff once procurement gives a green light.
>
> Priya

-----Original Message-----
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Oliver Hayes <oliver.hayes@lumenahealth.com>, Samantha Cho <sam.cho@lumenahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 16:22:00 -0800
Subject: Quick pulse — final microcycle approval & priority pulse?

Oliver / Samantha —

Bumping this thread as we cross the microcycle end. Two quick asks: 
1) Can you confirm whether procurement has the bandwidth to review the SOW this week, or whether we should shift to next cycle?
2) If approvals are still green, would you prefer a compressed 2-week canary (smaller scope) to unblock execution faster?

If useful I can join your procurement call to walk through the SOC2/KMS controls and call out the private deployment checklist. Marissa (cc'd) will own any technical handoff once procurement gives a go.

If I don't hear back by EOD Thursday I can follow up via phone — want to avoid last-minute surprises in your budget window.

Thanks,
Priya

Priya Natarajan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0123

On Mon, 23 Nov 2026 at 17:04:00 -0800 Samantha Cho <sam.cho@lumenahealth.com> wrote:
> Hi Priya —
>
> Sorry for the slow reply. Procurement picked up the SOW this afternoon. We're flagging two items that will need legal review: data residency language and indemnity caps.
>
> We're still trying to keep this in the current microcycle but I can't promise final signoff before the weekend. Oliver asked me to keep you posted — we'll aim to have a clearer answer by COB Monday.
>
> Thanks for the offer to join the call — I think a short huddle with procurement + security would help. Can you do Tuesday 11/24 at 9am PT?
>
> Samantha Cho
> Head of Security & Compliance | Lumena Health
> sam.cho@lumenahealth.com | +1 650-555-0998

> > - I'll need to route the SOW to procurement and our security lead (Samantha). Expect some redlines around data residency and contract term language.
> >
> > I'm on annual planning this week — I should be able to get initial feedback to you by Monday. If the approval timeline slips we may need to push into the next microcycle.

> > Best,
> > Oliver

Attachments referenced above: Lumena_SOW_v1.pdf, discovery-notes.docx

Notes: thread marked as a "priority bump" from AE after initial discovery; internal owners: Marissa (CS) and Ben (Sales Ops) on standby for pricing/commit questions. If approval slips, follow-up plan is to propose compressed canary and a 2-week execution schedule to keep momentum for Q4 planning.
